verdict.rationale: Radar's rule engine lets users define custom rules (block, review, request 3DS, allow via value lists) that trigger automatically based on payment event attributes, backed by extensive docs (stripe-radar-docs-1,2,3,10,14,17,23) and review-action APIs (stripe-radar-docs-8,21). However, community feedback notes friction with programmatic control and false positives requiring manual support intervention (stripe-radar-comm-2, stripe-radar-comm-3, stripe-radar-comm-7), and rules are primarily configured via Dashboard rather than a full rules-management API. Missing for 10: a dedicated public API for creating/editing rules programmatically, and stronger evidence of seamless automated control without manual overrides.
